_: C16a P3 energy bands, checked by tools/energy_check.py (pure Python, constants read from scripts/game_state.gd and scripts/mine.gd). route.floor_tries are measured on real layouts by tools/energy_route_probe.gd (gang arc, level 1, wood tools, 15 force_seeds a floor); the probe fails when they drift more than 2 from these.

route.what: Tom's case: through the meadow (one fight) and below mine floor 1 (floor 1 + half of floor 2 + their fights), day 1-3, level 1, wood tools

checkpoints._: Intended progress at each checkpoint (persona-neutral): main-skill level, sum of (level - 1) over all skills, tool tier, tree energy, gear energy, deepest mine floor, eaten tonic energy, friend perks, house/quest/festival growth, tree energy perk (farm/mine).

ceiling_sources._: every max-energy source at once (both arcs' friend perks counted): bram 25, posy 20, heart perks 70, Old Mags 20, forest shrine 20, house tiers 30, festival wishes/lanterns over 3 years 30, quests 10

personas._: A full working day per persona: actions by checkpoint. Bands: share of the day's usable energy (bar + food cap + rest cap) the day uses, and the share of the bar alone.

day_bands._: pct of the bar a full persona day uses. Early days must leave room (no forced pass-out on day 1, never more than bar + food + rest on any day); later days must still make the bar matter for the work-heavy personas. usable_max_bar_mult allows the longer days' extra recovery (40-min day: x1.4 food, x1.5 rest). late_min_bar_pct guards against regressions; the C16a target (late heavy mining 60-85% of the bar) is NOT met yet: see the P3 report.
